balls.text: And just the one run to finish - what an over from Bartlett this has been! Dubey went for the experimental shot once more, down on one knee as he looks to reverse ramp this, quite late into the trajectory of the delivery. Gets an edge off the bat and travels down to deep backward point
Another dot. Close to the blockhole once more. Harsh Dubey goes for a fancy sweep, on one leg, and the ball rushes past him before he can even get into position

Finally misses this, and Klaasen gets one in the slot, right in front of the stumps. He flicks this and surely he's got this for a six? Except he hasn't! It's gone straight to the deep mid-wicket fielder, and a rather un-Klaasen-like innings come to an end

What's happened here? The ball was on a length, outside off. Klaasen now goes for another reverse ramp. Does absolutely nothing to change the trajectory of this ball. Umpire turns down the appeal for caught behind, but they take another review - might as well! No edge, so on we go...
In the blockhole once again, right in front of the stumps. Great running to conver this thrash towards cow corner into another two, but Arshdeep on fire in the 20th
Great start, right in the blockhole. Klaasen opens up his front leg to slice the ball late, towards deep mid-wicket. They rush back for an impressive second run

Big appeal but umpire reckons this is going down leg! Arshdeep lands a great yorker, outside leg - it seems, mind you - as the batter goes for a late sweep. Got no bat on this. And PBKS aren't convinced the decision is a correct one, they go for a review. And yes, it's predictably pitching outside leg even on the DRS.

Salil hits this high, highhh, highhh in the air! He tried to keep a still head as he played this lofted drive with a high elbow, but his head fell to the side just a little. More importantly, he mistimed this ball on a length, near the stumps. There to be hit, to be honest... Bartlett ran in from long-on and his mittens collected that comfortably

French cut! Klaasen has really not found his touch out in the middle here... Was in the slot and had just enough width on offer outside off once more, but he only banged the ball right back into the pitch, off his inside edge
Goes for the blockhole, outside off. Salil flicks this from under his eyes, towards square leg
Arshdeep goes full, and Salil misses out. Looking for a yorker but lands in the slot outside off. Salil goes hell for leather with his swipe, misses it completely

Arshdeep goes for the slower one, and it goes horribly wrong! Had to wait for this slower bouncer to rise at Salil. He latches onto this one, swings across the line, and deposits this into the deep midwicket stand

Why move around the pitch when you can just bash it like that! It's full, fired into Klaasen's feet. He is standing outside leg, and he swings this one over the cow corner boundary. Most confident shot in a while
Klaasen pre-meditated this. Switches his footwork to try and scoop this one early, but the ball is banged in right on a length, in front of the stumps. Evades Klaasen's swipe and goes to the keeper
Keeps this full and wellll outside off. Salil times this one down to deep extra cover. A rather classy drive, but straight to the fielder

Another one in the blockhole - and now there's a shout from the keeper! Was this off the bat or did the batter just ram his willow into the pitch? Was well outside off, and they don't go for the review
Another one in the blockhole, this time on the fifth stump line. Gets down on one knee to glide this late, but it goes straight to backward point
Still full, but this time he lands it on the off-stump line. Klaasen digs this out and hammers it down to long-off
Goes full, but sprays this down leg. Klaasen's attempt at a sweep from behind him, on both legs, is half-hearted. Time to reload
Too full, and down leg. Klaasen is on his knees to sweep this one fine, towards deep fine leg
On a length, and spins into the batter. Salil defends this but gets the outside edge of the bat onto the delivery first. Runs down to mid-on and he gets off strike

Mix-up right as Aniket was gaining some momentum! Swipes at this full ball from in front of the stumps, not a great connection on this. Klaasen calls for a second run, so Aniket complies. But he hesitates for just a second, and it's enough for the wicket-keeper to break the stumps before he can make it back into the crease. Aniket walks off, throwing his head back in disappointment.
That one is hammered right down the pitch! Long on and long off converge, but the ball was shunted from its wide line outside off. He got one knee down and just timed the world out of this one
Chahal goes for a length ball, in front of the stumps. Initiative from Aniket again as he opens up his front foot and flicks this towards cow corner
Boshes this one into the stands over the cow corner fielder! Aniket gets down on one knee and swipes across the line, perfect connection and deep over the longer part of the ground
Rifles this in fuller. In fact, it's a full toss. He digs this out from in front of the stumps, but no power on it as it travels down to long-on
This one rises at Klaasen. He stands still and slashes this from close to his shoulders and across the line. Towards cow corner
Width on offer, outside off and on a full length. He drives this towards deep point with a high elbow
Goes fancy on this time, attempts a reverse ramp. But the ball is too full, on the stumps. He can only hit this along the ground towards backward point
Nails the yorker this time! Right on the stumps, and the batter can only get an edge back into the pitch. Dribbles away, so they get a run as the bowler runs to fetch it
Low full toss on the pads, searching for a yorker but going down leg. Flicks this towards cow corner
On a length once more, and Klaasen can only drive this down to long-on. What a great over, just seven runs from it...

On a length, rising at Aniket from in front of the stumps. He tucks this towards square leg and sets off. Not much timing on it but he pushed the ball into the turf, so he had the time he needed for the run
On a length, and driven straight down to a straight-ish long-on
Keeps it slow. Driven down to deep extra cover, sets off for a single
Fuller now, still on the pads. Klaasen drives this towards long-on
On a length, outside off, Klaasen gets this towards mid-wicket and has an easy run in his pocket to start the over

ABSOLUTELY ABSURD! How has Marco Jansen plucked that one out of the air? Kishan flicked this one off his pads, from in front of the stumps. Destined to go over the ropes, except Jansen runs in from the deep midwicket boundary - and with his wrong hand - plucks this out with just that one hand. Arshdeep Singh is on his haunches, perplexed, hand over mouth. Justified!
Klaasen mistimes this once more. On a length, on the stumps, he swishes at this awkwardly and it lobs into the air and falls short of mid-on
And now it's a slower ball outside off, Kishan's hand comes off his handle once more as he swishes this towards the deep square once again
Another full toss, going down leg, and Kishan misses out this time. Just takes the edge into his pads and the ball dies on the pitch
Kishan smacks this one over the ropes now! Goes for the yorker, but it is a low full toss on his pads. He just flicks this over the deep midwicket boundary

Absolute boshed by Klaasen, and Stoinis almost lunges in from deep extra cover to grab a stunner! It was pitched outside off, full-ish, and Klaasen did not time it as well as he might have liked. Falls just to the left of Stoinis
Kishan gets a hold of this one! Pitches outside off, Kishan reaches for it away from the body and thrashes this towards the covers
Slices this with no timing towards extra cover, and gets a run for his efforts anyway
Great fielding by Vyshak, diving to his left to cut off any chances of a run! Was on a length outside off, Klassen hit this right back at the bowler. One bounce off the pitch and towards the bowler
slower one once again, right on the stumps. Klassen pushes this from in front of his pads and towards cow corner, they come back for two
Slightly pace off, on a length and outside off. Kishan rushes down the pitch to meet this fuller, and that allows him to punch it to covers and take off
Back of a length, right on the stumps. Flicks this towards backward square leg and takes off for the other end
Fuller, on the stumps. Klaasen nails the drive this time - but without much power - to send it down to long on
Goes for a checked drive but an outside edge flies down to backward point. It was just outside off, on a length. Did not connect because the ball almost rushed into him
Jansen spears one into the stumps in the blockhole, Kishan digs this out with ease. Played towards cow corner
And Kishan's flicked this behind him, towards deep fine leg! It was on a length and on the stumps. Kishan moves towards the off side and beats deep square to collect four
A slowww one again. Sprayed on a good length but down leg side. Flicked comfortably, towards, square leg
Driven through the vacant covers. A comfortable ball on a length, outside off, to begin this over
Kishan reaches for this one. Kept well outside off, Kishan lets one hand go from his bat's grip as he reaches for it. Hit towards backward point
Another slow-ish ball, driven down to long-off. Klaasen gets to the other end
Thrashed into the cow corner boundary! The ball was slow, sat up and a bit of a nothing delivery. Right on the stumps and Klaasen stands still to push this away from the infielders
Goes back of a length, angling away outside off from the left-hander. Played down to long on and runs to the other end
Now he tries to thread a drive through covers. Finds the fielder despite timing a full ball
Smashes this one into deep midwicket! Just rose on him, just outside off, and gets the treatment it deserves
Length on leg, flicked to long-on
Not much spin when he bowls straighter. Fullish on off, punched to long-off
Keeper happy but that's called wide. Turn working against Chahal. Fullish length ball landed close to the tramline and was let go
Two to long-on's right. Good running. Was pitched up on leg, flicked with limited power
Turn but it's wide. Klaasen lets the fullish length ball go
Slight change in release from Chahal. Length ball goes down leg, let go
Length on leg, flicked through backward square leg
Pitched up at the stumps, flicked to long-on
Full on leg, flicked to short fine leg
Back of length on off, may have moved in, Kishan cuts to backward point
Back of length on off, no bounce, punched to long-off
Pitched up outside off, punched to cover

Shashank gets Abhishek for the second time! Taken on the edge of the cover boundary and Shashank charges across having dismissed Travishek. Was a wide fullish ball that Abhishek slashed. Looked like six off the bat but no.
Does well to take that. Wide ball on a fullish length, let go
Length on leg, flicked to deep midwicket

Projected score knows what it's doing alright. Shashank gets a wicket with a harmless ball. Wide on a back of length, may have been the slower one, and Head looked to drag it in with a pull. Connection made too far forward, bottom hand loses grip and ball flies to long-on
Six drought has ended. Chahal happy to give it air, goes at the stumps but Abhishek dances down and gets to the pitch. The cleanest of straight swings for a big six
Length on middle and off, Head makes room and cracks a cut off one leg. Through cover
Length on leg, flicked through midwicket
Appeal for lbw, seemed to have landed down leg. Not given. Length ball landed on leg and spun in, Abhishek slogged across. Wanted to go square
Length on leg, driven to long-off
Length just outside off, cut to point
What an over! Shashank might open the bowling next game. Multiple miscues, a toe-ender to finish. Shortish and wide, Head looked to pull it across, got it towards short third
Misses the scoop and ball hits the keeper's chest. Shortish 122ks ball angles away outside off, Head crawls across but can't get fully inside the line. Went too high too
Slashes, catch it is the call, no. Lands safe and goes to deep cover's left. Wide and a touch short, Head slapped it off the back foot
Four? No, a fine deep-backward point runs right and keeps it to two. Wide on a length, Head reaches out and taps it on its head
Pitched up on middle and leg, flicked to long-on
Beats bat first up. Skiddy length ball outside off at 122ks, Abhishek looks to go over cover
Wide and full, swipes across and gets it off the bottom of the bat, to mid-off. Timeout

That was six off the bat! 132ks shortish ball angling away well outside off, Abhiske walked across and pulled it from chest-height and signalled six as it sailed over forward square leg. Hundred brought up in 35 (legal) balls
Now we have the highest powerplay score this season. The free hit is a wide full toss, Head gets low and brooms it to deep-backward point

High full toss. Not given no-ball. Head reviews. Looks tight. Head's front was outside the crease, back foot in. He had a bit of room and tried to cut it. Ball went over the stumps. His waist is 1.02 metres, that went 1.1. No-ball it is!
Head's found his area. Backward point dives right in vain. This was a missed yorker, a shin-high full toss and Head square drove it with power
Wow, that's a leg-stump yorker sliced between backward point and short third! That's a shot for a wide ball generally but Head makes room, opens the face fully and dices it
Okay, hundred in the powerplay is on! Head makes room, gets a back of length ball that was still going leg side. Head lifts his front leg, swivels and pulls it fine
Near yorker has been dismissed like it's a slot ball. He takes a front stride and gets the ball just over his front boot, Abhishek drove it with a clean swing
Dances down and gets yorked. It's wide and guided with one hand to point
Abhishek gets to fifty in 18 balls, with another six! Does the L celebration again. Slower short ball outside off, sits up nicely and is belted over long-on
Launched. Abhishek uses the room offered and instead of going leg side, opens the face a touch while swinging to send it over long-off
Wide and fullish, Abhishek reaches out and swipes across. Gets it off the bottom of the bat back to the bowler
And gets a warm welcome. Abhishek dances down, makes a bit of room and scythes it off a fullish length over cover
Prabh... hasn't stopped it. Dove left, but ball was too quick. Head landing the bat with an open face, ball took the edge and picked up pace
Head's ready for the leg-stump ball. Made room, cleared the front leg and slugged across the line to clea the long-on fence
Cue-ended slog sweep lands close behind and rolls to short third's right. Fullish ball just inside the tramline, Abhishek swinging from where he stood
Length ball with pace follows Head, patted in front of point for a quick single
Swiped over extra cover, infielder may have felt he had a chance but the flat hit went well into the outfield. Full slower ball just outside off, Head getting low and making room nicely
Good line, that's all that matters for now. Just down leg, following Head as he backed away. Length ball is guided to backward point
Yorker and the over's finally done. Dragged across from outside off to midwicket

Doesn't matter, direction of ball-travel changes, not the result. Short ball under shoulder-height, 129ks, Abhishek clears the front leg and uses the angle going away to carve it. Top edge goes over third

Not wide, but it gets worse for Arshdeep. Goes back of length just outside off, 120ks, no pace off the pitch so Abhishek has ample time to get forward and flat-bat it from well in front of the body. Straight six
Change up, wide on height this time. Short ball bunged in hard and very far back, spongy bounce takes it well over head-height outside off
Third wide, could've been fourth. Arshdeep's front hand is moving in first slip's direction after he releases the back of length ball. Let go again
Dances down, Arshdeep keeps it wide outside off. Can't get away with it. Hard length, close to the edge of the pitch. Prabhsimran tells Arshdeep a review isn't worth it
Abhiskek moves across and misses out on a wide. He went early, Arshdeep wrung it on a similar line and length. Let go
Very, very wide length ball is let go. Not too far from going past the return crease
.Waits on the slower one and flat-bats it. Back of a length, a bit of room, rises to the top of the front thigh, Abhishek wound big and followed through fully
Short ball has been hauled from outside off. It rose to shoulder-height, Abhishek kept his eyes on it, stayed mostly upright and pulled it well in front of square
Back of length outside off, pulled off the bottom-half of the bat to midwicket
Mid-off in play but it's battered too hard. High and left of Shreyas it goes. Slower overpitched ball outside off, Abhishek walked towards the line, opened his stance and drove it
Predicatably, Bartlett goes wide. The full ball went over the tramline, let go. Abhishek surprised that's not given wide
Back of length around top of off, 131ks, punched with a vertical bat to deep point
Looks to drag it leg side from well outside off, the length ball angles away to beat bat and then half-volley the keeper to deflect sideways
Thumped down the ground. Abhishek stands tall and drives the overpitched ball through the line. Wobble ball first up
Bottom hand comes off again but there's contact this time. Head square drives it off a length to the right of deep point
Head swipes and misses. Bottom hand comes off as he looks to slap it through cover. 135ks scrambled seam ball is on the shorter side of length, slightly wide, and loses pace off the pitch
Slower one is cut to point. Length ball, top of fourth stump, a bit of movement in
Head sees the swing early, waits hops back and guides the back-of-length ball to short third. Direct hit but Head's bat is in
Another wide, further down leg than last one. This was full and Head tried to whip it fine
Good shape away, nicely handled. Abhishek gets forward and defends the fullish ball towards cover for a quick single
Width offered and he slashes it over cover. Enough bounce for him to stay on the back foot, the swing takes it away from him but still well within reach
Down leg, no swing. Length ball lands on leg and goes past the glance

How poetic for Shashank to finish off this game! An easy ball to dispatch, on a length and drifting down leg. Shashank obliges. He flicks this towards the vacant deep fine leg boundary. Goes to the other end, punches gloves with his skipper. His two-for changed the first innings completely, and now, he's finished off the game with bat in hand! Whaddaplayer
On a length, spinning away from Shashank. He steps down the ground and tries to deadbat this towards covers. He starts the run, but Iyer sends him back
It's almost a template now: the scores are tied too. On a good length, pushed down to mid-off, and Iyer lets Shashank finish this one off
On a good length in front of the stumps, and Shashank is happy to just push this towards mid-on
On a full length, and on the pads. He flicks this towards mid-wicket, had his head still and right over the delivery

How has he picked the bones out of this one? Another slower ball, kept well outside off. It's so wide that Shashank is on his tippy-toes and reaches for it. No way he can time that, except he does. And he boshes this over the cover ropes. Boggles the mind
Slow once off the pitch, well outside off. Iyer happy to cut this towards deep cover and run for it
Shreyas wants to get done with this! He's played a lofted drive, pushing this ball from its full length, outside off, into the deep extra cover boundary
Full and right on the pads, a casual flick towards long-on and Shashank is at the non-striker's end with a jog
Slower bouncer, pushed outside off. Shreyas uses his long levers to swipe this into the ground, towards deep midwicket
On a length, almost gets stuck in the pitch. Brings his bat down at the last moment to push this down the ground
Full, gives it flight and slows it through the air. Driven down to deep extra cover
Fuller now. He drives this down towards deep extra cover
And he's mistimed this one! But extra cover puts in a dive and fails to get the ball into his mittens. The ball was outside off, tossed up, great bowling. But the fielder couldn't get there in time
Drives this fullish ball from right in front of the stumps, and towards long-off
Shashank plays this inside out first up. Outside off and on a good length, not much timing on this but the extra cover area was vacant
Whaddaball! Wadhera goes for an extravagant lofted drive, but makes absolutely no contact. Dubey speared this into the stumps, and it takes off Wadhera's off-stump with little ceremony...

Back of a length, and rising right at Shreyas with no venom in it at all. Shreyas swipes this away across the line once more. Wonderful hitting, this. Deep midwicket can only watch it sail over his head
Goes for the slower bouncer, outside off. Shreyas tries to hit this late, jumping at it, but the ball drifts past him with no contact

In the slot, and Shreyas just swipes this over cow corner as if the ball was born to be deposited there!  He has brought up a rollicking 24-ball fifty, and each minute of it has been entertainment personified
Gets on one knee and boshes this into the deep cover boundary! Iyer spotted this full toss early, outside off, and knew he had to get under it to put it in the gap
Was there to be hit. But still, they'll get an extra on the board. Goes for the yorker but it's a full toss and drifting down leg, past Iyer's flick
This is a low full toss, right on the pads. Wadhera gets down at the ball and flicks this towards deep midwicket, happy to get down to the other end
In the blockhole, outside off. Wadhera goes for a drive but the ball rushes past him

And now Shreyas boshes this one over long-on! He's seeing it like a football at the moment. Not the cleanest of hits, and the fielder leaps in the air to see if he has a chance. Alas, it sails over the ropes. Was a low full toss and there to be hit...
Klaasen has let this one burst right through him! Shreyas now stands tall, outside off stump. The ball is latched onto, and bounces right in front of Klaasen at long-off

Shreyas expects the short ball, gets into position early, and absolutely bollocks this one over cow corner! Harshal speared this in short, but Shreyas had moved into the line of this slowish delivery to swipe across the line

Big appeal from Harshal, and then broken stumps too - eventful delivery! The ball was fullish, hits Iyer on the pads. He sets off for a run but then aborts the attempt. Was drifting down leg, the delivery, so Harshal doesn't press his point too much
A calm push towards towards mid-off to a length ball
Shreyas is so quick onto the offside here, stepping right in the line of this back of a length delivery. Thrashes the ball towards the deep extra cover boundary, but a fielder's stationed there
Low full toss, and an easy enough flick towards deep mid-wicket to close out the over
And now the flick - off a ball closer to his pads, on a length - towards deep midwicket. Easy single on offer
Wadhera attempts a cut off a wide ball himself. But reaches too far, gets just an edge, ball drilled back into the pitch
Dubey pushes this fuller and closer to the stumps, Iyer happy to play a grounded drive towards extra cover once more
Iyer latches onto this one! Harsh gives him room once again. Iyer steps into the leg side, and whacks this towards the deep extra cover area
Shreyas gets a late edge on this one. Was wide outside off, on a cuttable length, but hit straight to backward point
Spins away from the batter off a good length, going outside off. Shreyas happy to just cut this towards deep extra cover and retain strike
On a good length and spins back into Wadhera, who flicks this towards square leg
On the ack foot and down to the covers. Great timing on this backfoot drive to a length ball, but the fielder's waiting right there
Iyer almost chops this back onto the stumps! The ball is angled away from the skipper, who gives himself width and reaches for it. Underedge and into the pitch
Now back to the conventional shot. A simple cut, played late, to the ball spinning back into him off a good length. Gets off strike
Wadhera has ended up splayed on the pitch! He was looking to sweep this full ball from in front of the stumps, but he just loses his balance and spreads his legs in an awkward stretch instead
And now he's cut this late with the speed of a bullet train! The ball is innocuous, landing well outside off and on a full length. Shreyas threw his hands at this and middled it to perfection
Shreyas reminds us why he's him! The ball is in the slot, outside off. He picks up the length early and swipes across the line with those great wrists of his. Launched over cow corner
Another great drive, out to deep point. This was full and outside off, there to be hit, but luckily there's protection out in the deep for SRH
On a length, still keeping the line on the stumps. The captain happy to stand in his crease and play it down the ground
Slowish and kept outside off, Wadhera plays a smart drop shot into the pitch towards covers, and sets off for the other end
Speared in full, on the stumps, and he's happy to drive this down to long-off once more

And now the impeccable inside-out lofted drive! He's timed that to perfection, too - He stepped into the leg side. The ball was full-ish, on the stumps, but the width he manufactured helps him get this over the deep cover boundary
Pushes the length back just a little, spins this into the pads of Wadhera. He defends it straight back to the bowler
Tossed up on a length, outside off once more. He drives this down to long-off and collects a single himself
Begins by going on the front foot, to this ball full and outside off. Drives it towards long-on and sets off for a run

This goes hiiiiiiigh up in the air but Connolly mistimed this. Shivang is absolutely pumped, he lets out a lion's roar. And why not? The ball was tossed up, way outside off. But Connolly just did not have enough power on the shot, reaching out. He's walking back as a result
Spins this in quite full, drifting down leg, and Connolly sweeps this across the line - it thuds into the deep midwicket ropes! Great hit
Length on middle, flicked wide of long-on for a quick two
Slower one is full and outside off, square driven to deep point
Length on leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Wide and full, reaches out and smothers it to long-off
Pitched up on middle, flicked to long-on
Similar to what Shashank did. Skiddy on a back of length just outside off, driven to cover
Pitched up outside off, 85ks, driven to long-off

Shivang prises out Prabhsimran. Technically a hit-me ball. 83ks googly landed full and went away outside off, the bat-face opened upon connection and what was intended to be a straight hit went towards long-off. Klaasen ran in and took it sliding forward

This time it's helped over, launched over in fact. Prabhsimran gets fifty and a rousing reception. Length ball on middle, bater got across and inside the line. Swept it while ensuring his shoulders didn't get in the way
Overpitched but looped too. 89ks. Driven to long-on
Full just outside off, gets on one knee and sweeps to deep midwicket
Full on the base of leg, 88ks, whipped to deep midwicket
Big turn but that takes it down leg. Back of length ball landed on leg and Conolly looked to pull it fine
Well judged two to long-on. 93ks length ball on leg tapped softly towards long-on, good running
Driven into a length, it goes down leg with the angle. Prabhsimran tries to help it, misses
Full and flat on leg, 101ks, flicked to deep midwicket
Makes room and cuts it through point. Was a length ball on leg, Prabhsimran with his quick hands made pace again
Chopped to long-off. Shortish ball outside off, not turn, was skiddy
Darts one outside off. The length ball beats the cut, went under bat
Pitched up outside off, driven to long-off
Down leg, beats the leg glance
Back of length on leg, coming in with the angle, whipped back to the bowler
Good stop by Abhishek at cover, dives to the right and stops with one hand. Ball was wide and full, driven hard
Looked like a googly. Touch short and at the stumps, flicked softly through midwicket. Bowler and deep midwicket chase, keep it to one
Wide and full, driven to deep point. PBKS' hundred is up
Field is out and Priyansh has to go. He cleared deep midwicket last time but slog swept it straight to him this time. Shivang pitching it up and being rewarded, he is pumped too
Deep midwicket in place... and it goes just over him. He leapt to the right and landed over the boundary. Short ball was pulled hard, Priyansh's follow-through - to his back - is scary
Pitched up on off, punched to mid-off for a quick single. Timeout. 198 runs in 12 powerplay overs today
Priyansh makes room and looks to go over cover, misses. Ball almost hit top of middle, slower length ball and Priyansh went for a cross-bat shot
Harshal wants Priyansh to hit it off side, but the batter goes across and pumps it straight. Over mid-on, the lack of pace didn't disconcert him. Priyansh's fifty is up in 16 balls
Keep it straight, even when the ball's wide. Fullish and pacy, Priyansh swings across his knees and gets it over the bowler
Crazy. Priyansh gets across and belts a shortish ball over long-on. Couldn't free his arms but swung across his chest
Deep cover in place but Priyansh cares not. Wide and fullish, Priansh slaps it flat over cover
Back over the wicket and goes yorker. 141ks on off, Prabhsimran steps leg side and drives to cover
Length ball with pace follows Priyansh as he makes room, defended to cover
Slips out and gets blapped! 113ks full toss outside off, thigh-high. Offcutter gone wrong. Priyansh showed all three stumps and slapped it over extra cover
Slapped despite the fielders. Deep-backward point and sweeper cover out but he slashes the wide length ball over point for a flat six
Into the pitch and wide outside off. Priyansh shapes to go after it before leaving
Slower and short outside off, guided to deep-backward point

Prabhsimran's special, this time he manufactures a shot while being followed. He danced down and got a short ball over leg, he stopped in his tracks and placed the bat next to his shoulder to effectively ramp it to the deep-third fence
Very wide on a length, batter went back, was standing diagonally as he reached out and cut to deep cover
Wide and full, driven to deep cover

Return chance goes down. Unadkat stopped, got both hands up but it hit high on the fingers and went through. Was a fullish ball at the stumps, Prabhsimran went for the straight drive, got it off the inside-half
Replaced ball's new enough to be helped over even with pace off. Shortish ball on leg stump rises around hip-height, Prabh swivels and pulls it fine
Keeps Prabhsimran in the crease. Length ball in the channel is punched to mid-off

Very high... and very far! Goes over the sightscreen. This ball had no business going there. Length ball going towards top of leg, Prabhsimran made room and lifted it on the rise. Driven from knee-roll height with a full follow-through
Easier full toss but Prabhsimran happy to nudge it for a single. Knee-roll height, batter got low and closed the face to get it to deep midwicket
Very low full toss on leg, punched against the angle. Finds mid-off
Much better. Pacy, keeping the top of middle in play. Defended back to the bowler
Two deep fielders on the leg side and Malinga goes short and wide. Prabhsimran has to get upright and then carves it from shoulder-height over point
Dances down and flat-bats it to mid-off. Short of length on middle and leg, looked slow
Malinga is dispatched first ball. Fuller side of length and at the stumps, Prabhsimran gets back in the crease and drives through the line. Skiddy ball, picked from knee-roll height. Sails straight
This might be why Unadkat was brought in. To go slow, into the pitch and use the two-pacedness of the pitch. This ball rises spongily outside off and has Priyansh pull too early
Length on off, 130ks, defended to point
Slower length ball on off, defended towards cover
Same ball has been smoked! Prabhsimrah dances down early, turns a length ball into a fullish one. Swings around his hips and the ball goes high and far over long-on. 91 metres
Fullish outside off, driven to mid-off.
Bad ball, picked up with a flick. Full, not half-volley but was treated like one. It's on middle stump and is hit over midwicket
Down the ground again. He slides leg side again and gets a slot ball right beside him, lifts the back leg and thrashes a drive to mid-off's left
Straight six to a ball slanting away. Length ball on middle and off, Priyansh had an open stance, cleared the front leg and swiped across
Touch short, slower ball at the body; winds up big only to tuck it through midwicket

Appeal for lbw, not given. Ishan chats with Harsh... and takes it. Looked like it was going outside off on first view. It was a length ball that landed on leg, went with the arm and beat the slog sweep. The angle away was indeed taking it away, missing off stump
Miscues and gets away. Wide long-on comes in and stops it. Length ball around off, on the rise, Priyansh looked to lift it over mid-on with a vertical bat
Priyansh needs no sighters. Gets a length ball from around the wicket, he takes a stride forward and slog sweeps over midwicket. Too wide for wide long-on.
